name: How do I choose the best employment discrimination attorney in the San Diego area?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best employment discrimination attorney in the San Diego area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an employment discrimination attorney in the San Diego area, look for someone with specific experience in California employment law and a proven track record with discrimination cases. Consider their reputation, client reviews, and their understanding of local courts and agencies like the Civil Rights Department (CRD). Schedule consultations with a few attorneys to discuss their approach, fee structure, and how they communicate. Choosing an attorney who focuses on employee rights and understands the nuances of local employment practices can be beneficial for your case.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an attorney in San Diego with specific experience in California employment law, a strong reputation, and who clearly communicates their approach and fees.
